# Browser dependencies

These production browser bundles are served locally; no CDN request or package installation is needed at runtime.

- React and React DOM 18.3.1: https://github.com/facebook/react/tree/v18.3.1 — MIT; see `LICENSE.react`. Original bundle license headers are retained.
- htm 3.1.1: https://github.com/developit/htm/tree/3.1.1 — Apache-2.0; see `LICENSE.htm`. `htm.umd.js` matches the published 3.1.1 distribution.

Project code is covered by the root MIT license. These dependency licenses apply to the corresponding vendored files.
